auto_generate_session_for_account.description: The username of the service account (or {user}, {workspaceBot}, {workspaceAdminBot}) to auto-generate a session for

auto_generate_ai_key_for_account.description: The username of the service account (or {user}, {workspaceBot}, {workspaceAdminBot}) to mint a scoped OpenAI-compatible AI key for when workspace AI is enabled. Injected as GH_AI_BASE_URL, GH_AI_API_KEY, GH_AI_DEFAULT_MODEL, and GH_AI_MODELS; revoked when the run ends.

icon_path.description: The relative path to a workspace-local icon image. Preferred for user/workspace plugins that want to ship their own branded image. System plugins should use icon_name instead so the icon is served from the frontend bundle rather than needing a file-serving URL route.

icon_name.description: The name of an icon from the frontend icon registry (see lookupIcon / getIconNames in fileUtils.ts). Used for system plugins that live outside the workspace and therefore cannot serve a file via /api/view/. If both icon_name and icon_path are set, icon_name wins.

name.description: The name of the parameter used in the task script

group.description: The optional group that the parameter belongs to for grouping parameters in the UI

label.description: Label for the parameter for display in the UI

create.description: The file parameter is for a file that will be created

value.description: The default value of the parameter

optional.description: Allow the value to be optional

pattern_match.description: Acceptable file matches for the parameter

supports_location_mode.description: The file or directory parameter supports a location with Read Only, No Append or Read Write mode. Read Write is the default and other modes can be opted into if supported.

path.description: The path used for the file or directory selector. Can be a location or a {variable} between curly braces

stage.description: The stage name to pull the parameter from

stage_parameter.description: The parameter name of the parameter in the stage to use as the value

stage_parameter_expression.description: The expression to use to construct the value from the stage parameters outputs

persist_key.description: The key to use for persisting this parameter value at the workspace level. When provided, the parameter value will be saved and loaded as a default for future workflow runs.

install.description: Steps the checkout task runs after this plugin is installed or updated: in the server image, as the installing user, with WORKSPACE_DIR, GH_SERVER_URL, GH_WORKSPACE_ID and GH_SESSION_KEY set. They run on every install and update, so they must be idempotent.

env.description: Additional environment variables of the step

command.description: The command of the install step (default: bash)

args.description: The arguments for the command of the step

retry_count.description: The number of times to retry the plugin if it fails (default: 0)

retry_delay.description: The delay in seconds between retries (default: 1)

starting_url.description: The url to the starting page of the plugin

port.description: The port to expose the plugin on

env.description: Additional environment variables of the step

args.description: The arguments for the command of the step

docker.description: The docker settings of the step

image.description: The docker image of the step

shared_memory_size.description: The shared memory size of the task (e.x. 1g, 512m)

workspace_mount.description: The path to mount the workspace into the container

agent_requirements.description: The allocated resources for the task. These are hard limits enforced by the Docker container. The task must operate within the specified RAM limit; exceeding this limit will result in the task being killed.

agent_profile.description: A specific agent profile to use for the task (otherwise an agent profile that meets the requirements will be used)

cpu_cores.description: The number of CPU cores to allocate for the task

scheduler_cpu_cost.description: The CPU cost to use for scheduling the task. This can be less than cpu_cores if the task is not CPU intensive. If not specified, cpu_cores will be used

memory_gb.description: The amount of memory in GB to allocate for the task

runtime_limit_seconds.description: The maximum amount of time in seconds that the task is allowed to run. The task will be killed if it has not completed in this time

name.description: The name of the this resource profile (otherwise Default will be used)

description.description: The description of the this resource profile

alternative_agent_requirements.description: The available resource profiles defining CPU and memory allocations

description.description: The description of the resource profile

agent_profile.description: A specific agent profile to use for the task (otherwise an agent profile that meets the requirements will be used)

cpu_cores.description: The number of CPU cores to allocate for this profile

scheduler_cpu_cost.description: The CPU cost to use for scheduling the task. This can be less than cpu_cores if the task is not CPU intensive. If not specified, cpu_cores will be used

memory_gb.description: The amount of memory in GB to allocate for this profile
